When a caption is not present, you can see that the gatsby image HTML code is a
child of the fsimage tag, which is what we want.
"position: relative; display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 400px; "

But when we add a caption, our gatsby image HTML code is no longer a child of
the fsimage tag, but becomes a sibling!  This is no bueno.
